text: APPROVE. The extracted `CompareSegment` returns the same values as the old inline branches, and the mixed case's `-1` or `1` is nonzero so the caller's `c != 0` check still returns it exactly as the old early return did; this removes the nested if/else-if/else chain from `Compare`, bringing its complexity well under 15, and the new private static method compiles cleanly with no new warnings.
